charts.title: KELT-3 b: orbits around KELT-3
charts.description: The orbits of KELT-3's planets in this map from above, to scale, with KELT-3 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Yalçınkaya et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.530.2475Y), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname YALCINKAYA_ET_AL_2024): P 2.70339023 d

charts.title: KELT-3 b: its transit
charts.description: KELT-3 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (21, 48) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 67666096, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 13-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 13-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
